citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
The facility exhibited two African penguins at an event in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania on June 9, 2026. The travel to the
event required an overnight stay, and the licensee did not submit a written itinerary to APHIS.
Submitting an itinerary ensures that Animal Care is aware of regulated animal movement and exhibition within the
country, and allows for inspections to be performed at all sites.
A written itinerary is required to be submitted to APHIS no fewer than two days in advance of any overnight travel and
shall contain complete and accurate information concerning the whereabouts of any animal intended for exhibition at any
location other than the person’s approved site.
Correct by 06/11/2026 by ensuring that an itinerary is submitted for all future offsite exhibition that extends overnight.
This inspection was completed at the PA Capitol Zoo Day in Harrisburg, PA.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
